description: Answers a chat with open models on Aquedra Run's own GPUs: qwen3-8b (reasons before answering, and those tokens count as output and use up max_tokens, so set max_tokens to at least 1024); qwen2.5-3b (small text model for simple tasks); qwen2.5-coder-7b (code); qwen2.5-vl-7b (reads data: images). It runs only on idle GPUs: if the GPUs are busy the call fails with gpu_busy and retry_after_seconds, and nothing is charged. Limits are 8192 tokens of context, up to 2048 output tokens (a larger max_tokens is lowered to that, and the result then has max_tokens_requested) and 1 MiB of arguments, with no tools, JSON mode or embeddings; qwen2.5-vl-7b takes up to 2 inline data: images of up to 512 KB each, which together must fit in the 1 MiB. Costs per million tokens (input/output): qwen3-8b US$0.18/US$0.70, qwen2.5-3b US$0.05/US$0.10, qwen2.5-coder-7b US$0.025/US$0.05, qwen2.5-vl-7b US$0.18/US$0.69; minimum US$0.0005 per call, taken from prepaid credits and charged only when the call works; prompts and answers are not stored. Set dry_run to true to get the maximum a call can cost and max_cost_usd to refuse a call that could cost more.

dry_run.description: When true, return the most this call can cost (cost_usd, the hold) and the max_tokens it assumes, without running it or charging anything.

max_completion_tokens.description: Same as max_tokens; wins when both are sent.

max_cost_usd.description: The most this call may cost, in USD, as a number or decimal text with at most 6 decimals (e.g. 0.01 or "0.01"). A call that would cost more is refused with 402 max_cost_exceeded and nothing is charged.

max_tokens.description: Most tokens to generate, default 1024. A larger value than the output cap (max_output_tokens in GET /v1/models) is lowered to it, and the response says so in max_tokens and max_tokens_requested. qwen3-8b's reasoning counts toward it: send at least 1024.

oneOf.description: An inline image as a data:image/png|jpeg|webp;base64 URL (qwen2.5-vl-7b only, up to 2 images of 512 KB each, which together must fit in the 1 MiB request).

content.description: The message text, or a list of text and image parts.

role.description: Who wrote the message. The tool role is not supported.

model.description: Model id, default qwen3-8b. See GET /v1/models for the ones on sale.

stop.description: Up to 4 stop sequences of up to 64 characters each.

name: chat

balance_usd.description: Credit balance after the charge, US dollars as decimal text.

content.description: The model's answer; absent with dry_run.

cost_usd.description: What the call cost (or the most it can cost, with dry_run), US dollars as decimal text.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was run or charged.

estimated_prompt_tokens.description: Dry run only: the estimate of the prompt's tokens.

finish_reason.description: stop, or length when max_tokens ran out.

max_tokens.description: The max_tokens used: always with dry_run (the one the quote assumes); otherwise only when the max_tokens asked for was above the output cap and was lowered to it.

max_tokens_requested.description: Only when max_tokens was lowered to the output cap: the max_tokens asked for.

min_call_usd.description: Dry run only: the minimum charge per call.

model.description: The model that answered (or would answer, with dry_run).

price.description: Dry run only: the model's price per million tokens.

title: Chat with an open model
